case.title: 0.038 ETH shielded to the Confidential Intents treasury, not indexed anywhere public

provenance.status: Read from mainnet on 2026-10-27. The NEAR transaction is a successful execute_intents call whose signed NEP-413 intent transfers to the documented Confidential Intents treasury. It emits no ordinary token events, so the transfer was decoded from the signed payload. Both the 1Click status endpoint and the Explorer return no record of the deposit address or the transaction.
provenance.issue: Reported in near/intents issue #384 as a misroute with SUCCESS and no refund.

status.reason: No deposit address was available, so the status endpoint was not called.

notes: The Explorer API returned no swap matching 3djtQ3pUHv8SGtNKS3CMGice7E7S9oeS4DJzNYyjCUVD.
